tools.description: Find beers, wines, spirits, ciders and ready-to-drink drinks by name, style, origin or category across every open country node. Returns record ids with each record's CUVEE.

category.description: optional category to keep: beer, wine, spirits, cider_perry or rtd (ready-to-drink)

tools.name: search_drinks
tools.title: Search drinks

tools.description: Read one product in full by record_id: every field with its source page, reader and state; its CUVEE; its claim status; the signed record (JWS).

record_id.description: the record id, <node>:<6 digits>, e.g. es-bev:000123

tools.name: get_record
tools.title: Get record

tools.description: Find a maker and its products across every open node, with the maker's name as each source wrote it.

producer.description: the maker's name, or part of it

tools.name: find_producer
tools.title: Find producer

tools.description: List the countries on the record: each node's door, languages, state and, for an open node, its counts.
tools.name: list_nodes
tools.title: List nodes

tools.description: Compare two to ten products side by side, field by field, each value with its source page.

record_ids.description: two to ten record ids, e.g. ["es-bev:000123", "fr-bev:000456"]

tools.name: compare_drinks
tools.title: Compare drinks

tools.description: Get the maker's or distributor's trade channel to order a product, as the record states it. Never a consumer channel.

record_id.description: the record id, <node>:<6 digits>, e.g. es-bev:000123

tools.name: get_order_route
tools.title: Get order route

tools.description: Place an order intent for one to ten records (quantity, delivery market, optional date and note, the buyer's organisation and email). The Bourse routes it to each maker; verified makers answer with offers, and a maker's own Brand Agent address comes back with the routing. The email stays private: it is the buyer's key to read offers and accept one.

buyer.description: the buying organisation and its email (kept private; the key to read offers and accept one)

quantity.description: quantity with its unit, e.g. 600 bottles (75 cl)

record_ids.description: one to ten record ids to order, e.g. ["es-bev:000123"]

tools.name: create_order_intent
tools.title: Create order intent

tools.description: Read the makers' offers on an order intent, and the order once placed. By the buyer's email given on create_order_intent.

email.description: the buyer's email given on create_order_intent

intent_id.description: the order intent id from create_order_intent, oi-<16 hex>

tools.name: get_offers
tools.title: Get offers

tools.description: Accept one offer and place the order through the Bourse. Accepting is one x402 paid call (HTTP 402 with the payment offer until paid): it settles and signs the order. The goods are paid between the two companies on the offer's own terms.

email.description: the buyer's email given on create_order_intent

intent_id.description: the order intent id, oi-<16 hex>

offer_id.description: the offer to accept, as get_offers lists it

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.title: Accept offer
